title: Mood Glider Lip And Blush Stick
trechos: Ingredients List | | | | | | Read more | | | | | | | | | | Q: What is Mood Glider Lip & Blush Stick? | A: A multi-use balm stick that glides on smoothly and builds in clear layers of colour for lips, cheeks. It’s designed to look fresh, vibrant, and natural — not heavy or patchy. | | Q: What’s the texture like? | A: A soft solid balm texture that melts in as you apply, leaving a smooth, healthy glow without stickiness. | | Q: Is it buildable? | A: Yes — it’s specifically designed for buildable layering, staying clear and vivid even with multiple applications. | | Q: Will it ruin my base makeup underneath? | A: It’s formulated to glide and adhere smoothly without disrupting base makeup, thanks to colour pigments stabilised within a water-gel film. (Still: tap/blend gently for best results.) | | Q: Does it have a scent? | A: Yes — Milky Vanilla. | | Q: What are the key skincare-style ingredients? | A: A moisturising and barrier-supporting blend including Vitamin E + raspberry seed oil (“Vita-Berry”), avocado seed oil, plus moisture-supporting ingredients. | | Q: What finish should I expect? | A: A transparent, healthy glow — think “radiant and hydrated”, not glittery or greasy. | | Q: How do I apply it for the most natural look? | A: Twist up a small amount, apply to lips/cheeks, then blend by tapping with fingers or a puff. For a softer blush effect, apply to your hand first, then tap onto cheeks. | | Q: How do I do the “mood layering” technique? | A: Start with a base shade, add a point shade on top, then layer + blend to create your custom “mood mix” look. | | Q: The first swipe feels a bit firm — is that normal? | A: Yes. The stick is moulded in a dome shape, so it can feel slightly firm at first. Warm it up with body temperature for smoother glide. | | Q: How should I store it? | A: Avoid high temperatures.
